entries.message: Improves Up Next reliability, sync visibility, media-server recovery guidance, and manual watch review clarity.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Add clearer progress and removal feedback for background sync actions.
Feature: Add Help after two failed provider retries and publish Jellyfin connection troubleshooting guidance.
Tweak: Keep completed shows out of Up Next while retaining manually queued never-watched shows.
Tweak: Surface media-server connection retries inline and improve Sync Activity match issue handling.
Tweak: Media-page Up Next changes now appear promptly by prioritizing their sync and rebuilding stale queue projections.
Tweak: Existing provider requests finish safely before the priority update is sent.
Tweak: Refresh Up Next immediately after dashboard unwatch actions and keep valid manual watch reviews visible when older watch history exists.
Tweak: Require confirmation before applying individual or show-level watch and unwatched decisions from Manual Watch review.
Tweak: Show which connected app reported a watch and where dismissing the review will mark it unwatched.
Tweak: Organize Manual Watch review actions by show, season, and episode with concise provider-specific labels.

Tweak: Show newest review seasons first in boxed panels beneath the poster, preview only a few latest-season episodes, merge duplicate provider records into one row with source pills, remove the redundant show-level count summary, and remove accepted decisions optimistically while sync continues.
Fix: Use a generic Dismiss & mark unwatched action, send the unwatched correction to all configured media apps, and keep the dismissed row hidden while stale refreshes settle.

entries.message: Improve cross-platform sync and onboarding while making Up Next reliably include watched shows and select the first released unwatched episode.
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Add reviewable one-time Tautulli history imports with safe merges and preserved watch dates.
Tweak: Improve cross-platform sync and onboarding while making Up Next reliably include watched shows and select the first released unwatched episode.
Tweak: Keep Up Next aligned with media-page watch state, episode release dates, and TV-show actions.
Tweak: Standardize settings sections, help guides, backup controls, and onboarding access.
Tweak: Surface sync outcomes, retries, and unresolved media matches in the Sync Activity hub.
Tweak: Improve provider-aware watch-state synchronization and recovery safeguards.
Tweak: Up Next now checks every previously watched show, so new episodes are no longer missed because of a recency cap.
Tweak: Keep the Up Next rail on the first released unwatched episode instead of jumping to a later season.
